user_saw: Changing Visitor Access maxVisitors or defaultTtlDays while agent turns were active queued a full plugin replacement, so Gateway readiness failed and new runs were delayed for up to about a minute.
summary: Visitor Access now declares maxVisitors and defaultTtlDays as hot-reload prefixes and reads them live from committed runtime config, the loader only lends a retained Gateway plugin instance when the request's plugin config matches committed config, and config writes stop injecting managed-install unset paths.
reasoning: The fix sidesteps the generic exclusive-replacement drain (which it keeps for Cloudflare settings and explicit reloads) by opting the plugin's numeric settings into the existing hot-reload contract; the plugin never declared hot prefixes, and its code predates the 2026-09-03 graft. Whether the stall reflects an original design gap in the plugin or a later change to the plugin-reload drain machinery (many commits from #151706 to #184243 reworked replacement waiting on admitted work) could not be pinned to a specific line, so no cause is named.
